card.name: Partway through split words and numbers
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of a word or number that the model has split, such as 'Re' in Adverse Reactions, 'ca' in Precautions, 'ast' in trastuzumab, or the '1' in 14%. Fires on an unfinished piece, not a complete word.

modes.label: Split label words
modes.description: Opening piece of a word in a drug-label cross-reference such as Adverse Reactions or Precautions.
modes.example: Nausea, vomiting and diarrhea occur with Beleodaq [see Adverse<< Re>>actions ( 6.1 )]

modes.label: Split drug names
modes.description: Middle piece of a brand or generic drug name.
modes.example: avoid anthracycline-based therapy for up to 7 months after stopping tr<<ast>>uzumab when possible.

modes.label: Other split pieces
modes.description: Pieces of numbers or general words, such as a leading digit or the start of a book format.
modes.example: Renal impairment occurred in <<1>>4% of patients receiving LENVIMA

card.writes: The promoted tokens are a mixed set with no shared theme, and the suppressed ones all mean fragment or snippet, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on unfinished pieces of long words or numbers, mostly in drug labels.
